fusions.name: Edge Under the Rim
fusions.desc: Draws an edge from under the rim of your shell for a strike that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: From Inside the Shell
fusions.desc: Flicks a blade from inside your shell that deals 24 damage to the first enemy it meets. It only lands on a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Bait the Lunge
fusions.desc: Your critical damage rises by 40% for 15 seconds, and up to 3 enemies within 4 tiles are drawn onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Edge Kept Sheathed
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%. Your armour rises by 6%.
